protocol.selection: All returned NBA points main-line ranking rows that have fresh exact two-sided prices and both candidate/baseline pregame inputs. No side, score, probability or outcome filtering. One quote per market/game/player; ambiguous targets excluded.
protocol.timing: Freeze before kickoff. Compare both fixed models using the same frozen completed-game population and 48-hour prior-result lag. Exact input vectors, residual-artifact hashes and forecasts saved. No fitting or tuning in this script.
protocol.scoring: After exact official final: conditional OVER Brier excluding pushes, OVER/UNDER direction hits, fixed >=55% conditional win and >=3% EV research selections, unit ROI refunding pushes, paired fixture-cluster intervals. Report unresolved, pushes and all markets/sides; no cherry-picking.
protocol.limitations: Selected ranking-board cohort, not complete player population. Source revision and missing-context limitations remain. Models were developed on earlier inspected cohorts. Upcoming targets are new; only completion after this capture is eligible. Small samples cannot justify promotion; no fixed promised accuracy.

article.story: Memphis Grizzlies (4-0, third in the Western Conference) vs. Portland Trail Blazers (2-0, fourth in the Western Conference) Portland, Oregon; Thursday, 10 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Memphis will try to keep its three-game road win streak alive when the Grizzlies take on Portland. Portland finished 42-40 overall, 29-23 in Western Conference action and 24-17 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Trail Blazers allowed opponents to score 115.8 points per game and shoot 47.1% from the field last season. Memphis finished 25-57 overall and 19-33 in Western Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Grizzlies allowed opponents to score 120.7 points per game and shoot 48.5% from the field last season. INJURIES: Trail Blazers: Shaedon Sharpe: out (meniscus). article.title: New Orleans takes on Sacramento, seeks to stop 4-game skid
article.linkText: New Orleans takes on Sacramento, seeks to stop 4-game skid
article.story: Sacramento Kings (0-4, 15th in the Western Conference) vs. New Orleans Pelicans (0-4, 14th in the Western Conference) New Orleans; Thursday, 8 p.m. EDT LINE: Pelicans -5.5; over/under is 237.5 BOTTOM LINE: New Orleans enters the matchup with Sacramento as losers of four straight games. New Orleans finished 26-56 overall, 17-34 in Western Conference games and 17-24 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Pelicans averaged 115.5 points per game while allowing opponents to score 120.0 last season. Sacramento finished 22-60 overall and 14-38 in Western Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Kings averaged 16.4 points off of turnovers, 14.8 second-chance points and 37.9 bench points last season. INJURIES: Pelicans: Yves Missi: day to day (knee), Jordan Poole: day to day (ankle). Kings: Ben Simmons: out for season (achilles), Keegan Murray: out (ankle), Dylan Cardwell: out (calf), Maxime Raynaud: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
